name: exodo-urbano
description: Êxodo Urbano: cozy game 2D no cerrado (web, Android e iOS)
author: Tomás Antonio Albuquerque Souza Leones <tomasleones@proton.me>

scripts.build: npm run licenses && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:emu: npm run licenses && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode emulator
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-exodo "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run licenses && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode emulator --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-exodo "node tests/e2e/run.mjs"
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
